subject: [PATCH v9 07/32] x86: mm: add PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch adds helper functions for managing swap-exclusive PMDs (Page Map Entries) on x86 architectures. The goal is to allow a PMD-mapped anonymous huge page to remain mapped across a swap round-trip, which requires the PG_anon_exclusive flag to survive in a swap PMD. The new helpers reuse an existing bit in the swap PMD layout and assert that it does not alias with another reserved bit on 32-bit x86 architectures.
